facility.name: Pinnacle Children Academy
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips,Night Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 7751 BARKER CYPRESS RD, CYPRESS, TX, 77433

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Six infants was observed in the infant classroom with two caregivers.     Note: One caregiver reported just arriving in the classroom prior to Licensing entering the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Fed in Safe Manner: A child was observed drinking a bottle while laying in a bouncer seat.     Note: This was corrected when the caregiver removed the child from the bouncer seat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Fed in Safe Manner (26 TAC §746.2419(5))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Two infants was observed not strapped in while sitting in a bouncer seat.     Note: This was corrected when the caregiver removed the children from the bouncer seat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: A child was observed sleeping in a restrictive device.       Note: The caregiver removed the child once it was called to her attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Off When Not in Use: During the follow up, the television was on in the Toddler classroom when it was not in use.    Note: The television was turned off during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Off When Not in Use (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(6))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: As of today, the operation still has not had the annual fire inspection completed since January 29th, 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver did not know the correct number of children they were responsible for during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: A caregiver was observed on video hitting a child on the arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: A caregiver served children food while they were in their cribs and laying down on their nap mats.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: A caregiver placed an infant in a baby bouncer and did not fasten the safety straps. The infant almost flipped out of the baby bouncer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: A caregiver placed a child in a highchair when the child did not want to lay down and take a nap    The child was able to climb out of the highchair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: Children did not have their hands washed before eating.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep: A caregiver was observed forcing a child to sleep by making a child laydown on their nap mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: A caregiver grabbed a child by the arms, forcing the child down and when placing the child on their nap mat; the child hit the back of their on the nap mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver placed a child in a highchair and put the child in the hallway, closed the room door, and walked away leaving the child unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Caregivers were using their personal cell phones to talk and text while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: Based on the information obtained, children were watching television during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The annual fire inspection has not been conducted since January 29th, 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Nighttime Care - Screen Time Activities Meet Requirements: Observed children under 2 engaged in screen time during the inspection.    Note- The operation turned the television off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nighttime Care - Screen Time Activities Meet Requirements (26 TAC §746.3209(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: During the follow up inspection a caregiver yelled at children to sit down and stop running.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the follow up inspection, a caregiver left 6 children unsupervised in the pre-kindergarten classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregivers background check was inactivated on 8/19/25 and did not have an active and eligible background check during the inspection. The operation has not received a new eligibility determination letter from CBCU stating the caregiver can be present.    Note: The caregiver left the operation during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: The employee left in charge did not have access to children's files that were requested during the inspection.    Note: The operation provided the childrern's files when the owner arrived.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on the information obtained, there was sufficient to support that a caregiver has yelled at children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Documentation showing current CPR and First Aid training certificates for 2 out of 10 staff files evaluated were not available to review upon request during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Staff files evaluated were missing the following information:  - Proof of meeting the minimum education requirements  - Proof of the Background Check Request (Note-these were printed and placed in the file during inspection)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 2 out of 10 children's files evaluated were missing the address for the emergency contact person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Posting of Activity Plan: An activity schedule was not posted in the Pre-K 2 Classroom during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting of Activity Plan (26 TAC §746.2209)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: A child was climbing on the nap mats and a caregiver put the child in a restrictive device.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: 2 children were not signed in to the daycare's tracking system during the inspection.     Note: The operation signed the 2 children in during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The emergency practices was missing 3 months of documentation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The tarp under the loose-fill was showing and it could cause a tripping hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: There were no updated feeding instruction for an 11mos. infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center: There were menu available during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: There were no playground monthly check list available for review during the inspeciton.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report: There was  no health inspection available for review during the monitoring.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Sanitation Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: During the walkthrough three infants were on individual cots, beds or mats.     Note: This was corrected at the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: During the walkthrough, an infant was found in a restrictive device sleeping.     Note: This was corrected at the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Records-Available During Business Hours: During the inspection, two caregivers files was not available for review during business hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Records-Available During Business Hours (26 TAC §746.805(3))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: During the inspection, records showed that a caregiver did not have updated First Aid and CPR at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: During the inspection, records showed that a caregiver did not have updated First Aid and CPR at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
